name: Spain
spiritual_teacher: Retreats (Visiting teachers; no world-renowned local masters)
work_strategy: Hybrid / Remote (Ideal for living thanks to climate and prices)
it_market: Good (Strong hubs in Barcelona, Madrid, and Malaga)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; thereafter 19–45% PIT + mandatory Autónomo social contributions (~230–300+ €/mo); Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Warm (Sunny, ideal for living, though summers can get very hot)
nature: Sea, Ocean, Mountains (Pyrenees, Mediterranean Sea, Atlantic Ocean in the north)
english_level: Difficult (Low English proficiency; Spanish is mandatory for daily life and bureaucracy)
housing_rent: Moderate crisis (Prices are rising, but no multi-year queues like in the north)
citizenship: 10 years (Long path; formally requires renouncing previous citizenship)
mortgage_expats: Accessible (70-80% LTV for non-residents and TRP holders)
rent_to_buy: Common (Alquiler con opción a compra is a very popular legal mechanism on the market)
